title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E21 — Home Sweet Home For The Aged
Fred is caught up in a series of frustrating situations when he becomes a resident of a senior citizens' home. Fred is put in the home by Lamont, who plans to work his way around the world on a tramp steamer and doesn't want to leave his father alone.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E5 — George's Legacy
If Napoleon and Lincoln could do it, so can George Jefferson -- at least that's what George believes.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E6 — Good News, Bad News
An introduction to a friend puts Helen and Louise's friendship on the line -- and George couldn't be happier.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E7 — The Visitors
George and Louise are caught in the line of fire when Florence's battling parents pay the Jefferson household an unexpected and unnerving visit.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E8 — Camp-out, The
George may be over his head when he introduces his young clerk Marcus to 'roughing it.'.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E9 — The Last Leaf
When a superstitious Louise gets a 'sign' that her marriage is doomed, George is forced to make a decision that could change the rest of their lives.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E10 — Louise's New Interest
Is Louise going away on a weekend Indian 'dig' because of her interest in archeology or in the handsome archeologist? And that's exactly what George and Helen want to know.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E11 — Costume Party, The
George's cleaning business may be cleaned up for good when he resorts to playing a dirty trick in order to secure the business of a large costume company.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E12 — Florence Gets Lucky
George must make a painful admission when he discovers he needs Florence far more than he could ever expect.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E10 — Bobby Darin, Charley Pride, Ella Fitzgerald
Cast sings 'Who?' with George Wyle on piano; Darin’s a rabid football fan, then the devil battling Rev. Leroy.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E13 — Sid Caesar, Bobby Darin
Sid plays a hip musician, Jekyll & Hyde and a slot machine; Bobby & Flip offer a vaudeville routine and the cast does a silent movie.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E6 — Bill Withers/Mae Jackson
Featured guest Bill Withers sings hit single, "Ain't No Sunshine" and other selections from his album, Just As I Am.  In another segment, young poetess Mae Jackson reads from her own works.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E7 — Miriam Makeba/Muhammad Ali
Former heavyweight boxing champion Muhammad Ali, South African born singer Miriam Makeba and a three-man vocal group called the Delfonics, share the spotlight with guest-host Nikki Giovanni, who opens the show with her "Kidnap Poem".

title: Webster
description:
S5 E18 — See George Run
George investigates why he was suddenly dropped as an endorsed candidate for the Board of Education.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E1 — The Wild, Wild Webst
Webster fantasizes that he is a hero in the Wild West defeating a bully.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E2 — The Painting
At an art gallery, George glimpses at a truly shocking work of art: a nude portrait of Katherine in her younger days.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E3 — The Quiz Show
Webster and his classmates face some unfair competition when they're contestants on a TV quiz show.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E4 — Papa's Big Romance
George's dad Papa Papadapolis picks up a new hobby and ends up on a date with the instructor: a belly dancing teacher!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E3 — Gimme a Brake
Tempted by the freedom of a new car, Tia and Tamera soon find themselves on a collision course with disaster when their car drops off a dock and into Lake Erie!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E4 — Daddy's Girl
Tamera learns she's never too old to be a daddy's girl when she finds herself jealous of the growing closeness between Ray and Tia.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E5 — Sis Boom Bah
In a bid to boost their popularity at school, the twins try out for the cheerleading squad -- and Ray tries his hand at coaching them.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E6 — Kid-Napped
When a new girl in school threatens Tia and Tamera's popularity, the twins join forces to win back their friends with the help of a music superstar.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E7 — Boy From the Hood
Tamera falls for Tia's childhood friend Darnell, who's all grown up and running with a fast crowd.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E19 — Something About Moesha
Having been neighbors and friends nearly all their lives, Moesha and Hakeem wonder if there is more to their relationship.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E20 — The Robbing Hood
Moesha and Hakeem explore their evolving dating relationship.  Dorian visits Moesha on campus and Moesha sees this as a chance to forge a sister/brother relationship; items begin missing from dorm rooms and all clues lead towards Dorian.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E21 — Arriving Right On Q
Moesha and Hakeem’s relationship hits a snag when Q returns to town; sparks fly between Moesha and Q;  Q invites Moesha to spend the summer (as a road manager) on tour with his rap group.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E22 — D-Money Loses His Patience
Hakeem tries to convince Moesha to pass on Q’s offer to go on the road with his band, and focus on her priorities: school, family, and him.  Moesha admits to being too distracted to make a clear decision.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E1 — On The Rebound
Moesha and Q decide whether or not to take their relationship to the next level; Dorian returns home from boot camp.

S3 E18 — Sweet Sixteen
Though Brenda's but a week away from her sixteenth birthday, a milestone marking newfound dating freedom, Mary refuses to bend the rules and allow her to accept Calvin's invitation to the party of the year.

S3 E19 — Blues
When Brenda's grandfather gives her his treasured collector's blues recording, she accidentally scratches the record and learns first-hand what the blues are all about.

S3 E20 — The Roommate
When Mary and Lester assume the role of temporary foster parents, they're horrified to find Sandra's erotic lifestyle rubbing off on the impressionable co-ed.

S3 E21 — Best Friends
When Mary's best high school chum, a successful television psychologist, pays her a visit, Mary feels somewhat inadequate when compared with her celebrity friend.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E12 — Sh-boing-boing
After an argument with his wife of 49 years, Malcolm's grandfather arrives to stay with him and Eddie.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E13 — Club Story
Eddie offers to take over at the bar so Malcolm can dine with his girlfriend's wealthy father.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E14 — Lock Down
Ticket scalping gets Malcolm and Eddie jailed on the eve of Martin Luther King Day.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E15 — Hai Karate
An unruly customer challenges Eddie to a fight; Nicolette and Holly try being roommates.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E15 — 984 W. 124th., Apt. 5c
When Louise discovers that George has been sending presents and money to a mysterious address, she follows him to find out why and is shocked...and touched by what she sees.
